description: Independent exact-ratio oracle. This fixture was authored from the cited definitions and integer/rational arithmetic, without reading catalogue declarations. Generated Hale tests and the actual declaration-graph verifier consume this same static oracle.

bipm_si.title: BIPM SI Brochure, ninth edition
bipm_si.basis: SI base/named units, exact defining constants, litre, tonne, time, and angles.

bipm_prefixes.title: BIPM SI prefixes
bipm_prefixes.basis: Independent decimal exponents from quecto (-30) to quetta (+30).

nist_811.title: NIST SP 811, Appendix B.8
nist_811.basis: Defined customary and scientific conversions; rounded table entries were not used as exact values.

nist_footnotes.title: NIST SP 811 conversion footnotes
nist_footnotes.basis: Exact pound, pound-force, nautical mile, cubic inch, IT Btu and thermochemical/IT calorie definitions.

nist_foot.title: NIST revised international-foot conversion factors
nist_foot.basis: International foot, fathom, mile, acre, square mile and acre-foot; not obsolete survey-foot approximations.

nist_gallon.title: NIST SP 1038
nist_gallon.basis: US liquid gallon is 231 cubic inches and 128 US fluid ounces.

iupac_concentration.title: IUPAC Gold Book: amount concentration
iupac_concentration.basis: Amount per mixture volume; mol/L and mol/m3 with SI prefixes.

iupac_molality.title: IUPAC Gold Book: molality
iupac_molality.basis: Amount per solvent mass; prefix conversions do not change the solvent basis.

iec_binary.title: BIPM SI Brochure: binary prefixes
iec_binary.basis: IEC binary prefix powers of 2, including robi and quebi; byte is eight bits.

native_limitations: Native runtime equality uses an i64 common denomination, so coefficient products must leave room for signed multipliers 1, -1 and 3.
Large exact relationships that fit individual literal counts use compile-time exact conversions in both directions.
Relationships beyond i64 literal/Duration headroom remain graph-only, with an explicit reason; they are not counted as native passes.

Unary minus does not preserve the compiler exact-literal narrowing proof. Literal-only tests therefore negate already-converted values; runtime strategies directly exercise signed conversion arithmetic.
Three native Duration comparisons widen both operands exactly to picoseconds to avoid mixed Duration/Int codegen at the canonical nanosecond meet. The fixture labels these bridges explicitly.
